_source: 5x5 consequence x likelihood matrix following the ADOSH-SF Risk Management Technical Guideline structure. Level definitions are written for an alumina refinery and can be edited without code changes.

1.name: Insignificant
1.definition: No injury or first aid only; no production impact.

2.name: Minor
2.definition: Medical treatment case or restricted work; minor spill contained on site.

3.name: Moderate
3.definition: Lost-time injury; reportable release contained within the refinery boundary.

4.name: Major
4.definition: Permanent disability or multiple lost-time injuries; significant caustic or steam release.

5.name: Catastrophic
5.definition: One or more fatalities; major uncontrolled release or fire.

1.name: Rare
1.definition: No similar hazard reported in this area in the look-back window.

2.name: Unlikely
2.definition: 1-2 similar hazards reported in this area in the look-back window.

3.name: Possible
3.definition: 3-5 similar hazards reported in this area in the look-back window.

4.name: Likely
4.definition: 6-10 similar hazards reported in this area in the look-back window.

5.name: Almost certain
5.definition: More than 10 similar hazards reported in this area in the look-back window.

bands.action: Manage by routine procedures; close within 30 days.
Area Owner to plan controls; close within 14 days.
Supervisor alerted; interim controls within 24 h; close within 7 days.
Stop the activity; supervisor alerted immediately; close within 24 h.
